sentences.text: Mr. Sarda, learned Advocate for Applicant submitted that, the Applicant and Respondent No.2 were having an affair and the act as alleged Osk 31-Apl-847-2025.doc under Section 376(2)(n) of I.P.C. was a consensual act between two adult persons.
He submitted that, when their relations got soured, present crime is registered.
That, now their disputes and differences have been resolved and Respondent No.2 is giving her consent for quashing of the crime in question.
He therefore prayed that, the said crime may be quashed with the consent of Respondent No.2.
3) Ms. Walimbe, learned Advocate for Respondent No.2 tendered across the bar her Affidavit dated 17th July 2025 duly affirmed before a Notary Public.
In para Nos. 3 & 4 thereof, the Respondent No.2 has admitted the act of amicable settlement and her desire to perform new marriage.
In para No.4 itself, the Respondent No.2 has given her no objection for quashing of the crime in question.

3.1) Respondent No.2 is personally present in the Court and through her Advocate reiterates the contents of her Affidavit dated 17 th July 2025 and her 'no objection' for quashing of the crime in question.
4) Perusal of F.I.R. indicates that, the Respondent No.2 was earlier married, however in the year 2020 got divorce with mutual consent from her husband.
In December 2022 she got acquainted with the Petitioner and their acquaintance was blossomed into an affair.
By extending promise to marry with Respondent No.2, against her wish the Applicant established physical relations with her.
The Applicant also induced Respondent No.2 to avail loan in her personal name and utilized the loan amount for his personal benefit.
Osk 31-Apl-847-2025.doc
Their relationship got subsequently soured and thereafter the Respondent No.2 has filed present crime.

It appears to us that, when the Respondent No.2 entered into relations with the Applicant, she was an adult person and the relations between the Applicant and Respondent No.2 were consensual in nature.

5) In view thereof, we are inclined to quash R.C.C. No. 272 of 2024 pending on the file of learned Judicial Magistrate First Class, Pimpri, District Pune, arising out of C.C. No. 1248 of 2023, dated 28 th December 2023, registered with Pimpri Police Station, Pimpri-Chinchwad.
